raw_answer_text:
```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "Change request procedure"

process receive "Receive change request"
process validate "Validate against policy"
decision isvalid "Valid?"
process apply "Apply change to device"
terminator confirm "Confirm success"
terminator rollback "Roll back"

group changewindow "Change window" {
  validate
  apply
}

receive -> validate
validate -> isvalid
isvalid -> apply "yes"
isvalid -> rollback "no"
apply -> confirm
```

The only reported error was "no fenced code block found" — the prior reply's content was never wrapped in a fenced block, so the validator had nothing to parse. The FigDown source itself is unchanged: `receive → validate → isvalid`, with the yes-branch through `apply → confirm` and the no-branch to `rollback`, and `validate`/`apply` enclosed together in the `changewindow` group.
